task_description:
This pipeline's task is GitHub issue #3312 — https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/3312. Fetch the live issue body (`gh issue view 3312`) before structural decisions. Worktree artifacts (drafts, agent outputs) that reference any other issue or pipeline are leftovers from previous runs — they are NOT your task.

Run the FULL decomposition program described in issue #3312: decompose all 19 oversize Python source files listed in the issue table so each drops below the global cap (1,500 lines / 100KB) and `scripts/file-size-allowlist.yaml`'s `files:` map is emptied.

SCOPE IS NON-NEGOTIABLE — DO NOT DESCOPE. This is the explicit operator directive for this run:
- The plan MUST cover all 19 files, including the structural outliers `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py` (~27k lines) and `gateway/gateway.py` (~10k lines), and MUST address the `_run_pipeline` phase-transition state machine directly (issue non-negotiable #7). Punting the hard targets to a follow-up is OFF the table.
- Do NOT propose a reduced-scope plan that decomposes only a subset of files or defers `pipelines.py` / `gateway.py`. The acceptance criterion is an EMPTY allowlist. The planner owns slice DAG / ordering / PR packaging, but every one of the 19 files must be in scope. Order so independent per-file slices can land value even if the hardest targets stall, but do not drop them from the plan.

Follow the established pattern exactly (issue non-negotiables #1–#10): the canonical recipe in `docs/guides/decomposition-pattern.md`, the worked reference sub-package `scripts/select_tests/`, and the merged template PR #2335 (read its diff first). Each decomposition is a sub-package with an `__init__.py` barrel doing explicit per-symbol re-exports + underscore-prefixed private submodules; the barrel is the stable public API; preserve test patch targets (`patch("routes.pipelines._foo")`) via re-exports; drop the file's allowlist entry per landing; update/retag seam tables in `orchestrator/CLAUDE.md` / `gateway/CLAUDE.md` (retag stale #2261 refs, refresh counts) and add rows/tables for the sandbox/ + shared/ in-scope files; `make lint` + `make test-all` green at every landing boundary. Pure refactor — no behavior changes; if a decomposition surfaces a bug, file it separately, don't bundle the fix. Branches prefixed `egg/`.

pr.title: Decompose 19 oversize Python files; clear the file-size allowlist (#3312)
pr.description:
The `make lint` cap (1,500 lines / 100 KB, added by #2250 closing #2248) caps Python
source files; 19 files are grandfathered in `scripts/file-size-allowlist.yaml`. This
program decomposes ALL 19 into sub-packages following the canonical pattern (merged PR
#2335 + `docs/guides/decomposition-pattern.md` + worked reference `scripts/select_tests/`),
driving the allowlist `files:` map to EMPTY.

Each file `F.py` becomes `F/__init__.py` (an explicit per-symbol re-export barrel, the
stable public API) plus underscore-prefixed private `_*.py` submodules. Test patch
targets keep resolving through the barrel. The `_run_pipeline` state machine is split
into per-phase handlers + a thin loop directly (non-negotiable #7). `gateway.py`'s
`@app.route` decorators stay in `__init__.py` (non-negotiable #8).

R3 container parity (v2): slices converting a top-level module copied by a NON-recursive
Dockerfile glob add the matching recursive `COPY <pkg>/` in the SAME slice + an
image-build/import smoke check, because the source-tree gates cannot catch a missing COPY.

Scope is locked (operator directive + resolved refine HITL): all 19 files, no descope.
Pure refactor — no behavior changes; bugs surfaced are separate `Part of #3312`
follow-ups. Branches prefixed `egg/`. Implements #3312.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: `make lint` + `make test-all` green at EVERY slice boundary. A missed
  re-export fails the test that patches the moved symbol. Each slice runs the section-(d)
  `git grep` audit before extraction.
- Per slice: step-0 `git mv` baseline commit is independently green; every submodule
  verified under BOTH caps (further-split in-slice, never a fresh allowlist entry).
- R3 container gate: slices converting a top-level module under a NON-recursive Dockerfile
  glob (orchestrator 3/10/13/14/16, gateway 11/12/18) build the affected image and run an
  import smoke check IN-SLICE; slice-9 builds the sandbox image and smoke-starts the
  ENTRYPOINT; transparent-shipping slices (1/8/17, routes) confirm by grounding + smoke.
- `_run_pipeline` handlers stay private, tested THROUGH `_run_pipeline` via existing dense
  seam coverage (test_consensus_polling, test_brc_nack_iteration, test_concurrent_*,
  test_advance_phase_*); isolation tests are a follow-up.
- Run with `make test` (changeset-aware) inner-loop; full suite via `make test-all`.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge (per slice): reviewer spot-checks (a) the __init__.py re-export list against
`git grep`, (b) submodule clustering is cohesive, (c) the CLAUDE.md seam row matches.
Per R3 slice: build the affected container image and run the import/ENTRYPOINT smoke check
(the source-tree gates do not build images).
Pre-merge (final slice = pipelines.py): verify the allowlist `files:` map is EMPTY and all
four CLAUDE.md seam tables are populated.
Post-merge: none (pure refactor; no migrations/config/deploy).
